outline:
先修課程：3002012或負責教授同意。介紹各種不同分析方法（如能量法及Castigliano定理）、破壞理論、材料選用、可靠度概念、軸及軸承、離合器及煞車器、傳動元件(如皮帶、鏈條、齒輪)、軸聯接器、飛輪、彈簧等。
Prerequisite: ME212 or Consent of Instructor Introduction to Analysis Methods (Energy method & Castigliano theorem),
Failure Theory, Material Selection, Introduction to reliability, Shafts and Bearings, Clutches and Brakes, Power Transmission Elements (Belts, Chains, Gears), Couplings, Flywheels, and Springs.
schedule:
1. 機械設計概論
2. 破壞理論
3. 元件設計與選用
a. Shafts and shaft components
b. Screws, fasteners, and the Design of non-permanent joints
c. Welding, bonding, and the design of permanent joints
d. Mechanical spring
e. bearings
f. gears
g. Flexible Mechanical elements
scorePolicy: 作業&課堂表現 期中考 , 期末考
materials:
1. Shigley‘s Mechanical Engineering Design (10th edition) international edition 2015 by Budynas & Nisbett (中譯本9th)
2. 機械設計(第四版),光灼華等,2019, ISBN:9789865030117.
